title: Offline Markdown renderer for the daily macro brief
objective: Render a deterministic Chinese Markdown daily brief from the normalized offline macro model. The renderer is presentation-only: it performs no collection, scoring, provider call, schedule or Feishu delivery.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify existing source, migrations, fixtures, task specifications, ledger, providers, credentials, schedules or delivery integration.
Do not read or use API keys, invoke Dune, make network calls, send Feishu messages or create a scheduler.
Do not add a cross-chain score, trading recommendation, execution decision, market prediction, or a claim that a blueprint is execution-verified.
Do not render an unverified metric as a real value; unavailable data must remain explicitly unavailable with provenance warnings.
deliverables: A pure renderer from MacroDailyBrief to Chinese Markdown.
Stable sections for global attention, Solana, BSC, Robinhood and data quality.
Formatting for units, source/query provenance, completeness, coverage and machine-readable warnings.
Focused tests that prove deterministic order, Robinhood partial coverage, warnings, unavailable sections and no recommendation wording.
